answer: Jurors stake 22% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The quartz panel is drawn blind, the comet escrow settles at close, and vertex lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 425 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
